task: Native HY104 EMA22 strategy-outcome classification, context vs context plus SI
status_at_registration: No corrected-cohort fits; dataset pending freeze and parent go-ahead
fit_matrix: Each fixed classifier independently in both arms, on the identical frozen fold IDs; no search
source_policy: Correct 348 native trades in 242-session year; main cohort after ES SI archive starts; never use old 347 C28.03 or standalone SI15m labels

targets.primary: Frozen y: actual native strategy exit net after normalized roundtrip 5.74 USD, then additional 25 USD cost stress > 0; not a fixed 15-minute markout

splits.purge: Training outcomes must be known strictly before frozen test information cutoff
splits.fold_source: Canonical dataset builder; no local fold optimization

preprocessing.missing_values: column train median, zero if all train values missing
preprocessing.missing_indicators: One indicator per input feature, always present
preprocessing.scaling: Train means and population standard deviations after imputation and indicator append; zero standard deviations become one
preprocessing.SI_absence: Null is unknown, never evidence of no SI; coverage status provided as explicit numeric features

prediction.TabPFN: One test row per predict_proba call; official V2 checkpoint, CPU, no cloud; categorical indices side, SI_status_code when present, and every appended missing flag
prediction.others: Native predict and native predict_proba only for models that implement it; decision_function retained as raw scores
prediction.probability_clip_for_scoring: Only sklearn log_loss numerical endpoint handling; actual probabilities saved unmodified

shortages.one_training_class: Skip both arms of that model/fold/target with explicit reason
shortages.minority_n1: Fit fixed settings; record counts and warnings; no synthetic samples
shortages.one_test_class: Save forecasts/accuracy; AUC undefined null, with reason
shortages.fit_failure: Retain error, stop model pair; do not silently switch algorithms

descriptive_only: Pooled AUC across folds; margin scale may vary by fold
metrics.baseline: Train-only Laplace positive prior, no fitted features
metrics.selection: No winner deployment, threshold search, gate, native SQX job or payout claim

limits: Selected historical year is development data, not fresh OOS
Very sparse SI overlap and incomplete feed uptime limit inference
Strategy outcomes are not portfolio payouts
Seven model families and two arms are exploratory multiple comparisons
